senses.gloss:
शुभ् 1. शुभ् (perhaps for an original
श्वभ्, cf. rts. शुध्, शुम्भ्), cl. 1. A.
शोभते (rarely cl. 6. P. शुभति or cl. 1. P. शो-
भति, but this latter is referred to rt. 3. शुभ्), शु-
शोभ, शुशुभे, शोभिष्यति, -ते, अशुभत्, अशो-
भिष्ट, शोभितुम् (Ved. Inf. शोभसे, शुभम्,
शुभे, see 2. शुभ्), to shine, be splendid; to be
beautiful, look beautiful or handsome, appear to ad-
vantage; to be gay or happy; to be victorious,
triumph over: Caus. शोभयति, -ते (Ved. also शु-
भयति), -यितुम्, Aor. अशूशुभत्, to cause to
shine, ornament, decorate: to adorn one's self (A.);
to shine (?): Desid. शुशोभिषते, -ति, or शुशुभि-
षते, -ति: Intens. शोशुभ्यते, शोशोब्धि, to shine
intensely; [cf. Gr. κομψός, κομ-μός, κομέω; Old
Germ. sūbar, ‘pure;’ Mod. Germ. sauber; Lith.
źibbu.]

2. शुभ्, प्, f., Ved. splendor, beauty, brilliancy,
glory; happiness; victory, triumph, (शुभे, for
victory or conquest); an ornament; an auspicious
offering; a brilliant place of sacrifice, (Sāy. = शो-
भन देव-यजन, Ṛg-veda I. 23, 11); water
or a brilliant chariot (= उदक or रथ, Ṛg-veda
I. 167, 6, &c.).
—शुभं-या, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved.
causing happiness, bestowing blessings, benevolent
(said of the wind; Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 3, 6. ex-
plains शुभं-ये by शुभस्य प्रापयित्रे, con-
necting या with rt. 1. या in the sense of प्रापणे).
—शुभं-यावन्, आ, &c., Ved. going to splendor
or happiness (said of the Maruts, Sāy. = शोभन-
गति, शोभनं गन्ता; cf. ऋण-यावन्).
—शु-
भस्-पति, इस्, m. lord or preserver of splendor,
(Sāy. = शोभनस्य कर्मणः पालकः); (ई), m.
du., Ved. epithet of the two Aśvins.

शुभ् 3. शुभ् (sometimes written शुन्भ्
or शुम्भ् = rts. सुभ्, सुन्भ्, सुम्भ्),
cl. 1. P. शोभति, शुन्भति, &c., to shine [cf. rt.
1. शुभ्]; to speak; to strike, injure, kill.
सुभ् सुभ् or सुन्भ् = rt. 3. शुभ्, q. v.

शुभ, अस्, आ, अम्, bright, shining, splendid, hand-
some, beautiful; auspicious, fortunate, lucky, happy,
well, right, good, virtuous, eminent, distinguished;
learned, versed in the Vedas; (अस्), m. the twenty-
third of the astronomical Yogas; a city in the sky,
(see व्योमचारि-पुर; said to be also fem. and
neut.); (आ), f. light, lustre; beauty; desire; N. of
a female friend and companion of the goddess Umā;
an assembly of the gods; bamboo-manna; white
Dūrvā grass; the Śamī tree; the yellow pigment
गो-रोचना; a particular plant, = प्रियङ्गु; (अम्),
n. anything bright or beautiful, auspiciousness; hap-
piness, hail, welfare, good fortune, good; an orna-
ment; water, rain, (Sāy. = अलङ्कार or उदक,
Ṛg-veda VII. 82, 5); a fragrant wood (= पद्म-
काष्ठ); [cf. Pers. خوب khūb.]
—शुभ-कर,
अस्, आ or ई, अम्, causing welfare, producing good,
propitious, &c.
—शुभ-कर्मन्, अ, n. a good or
virtuous act, auspicious action; reputable occupation
or employment.
—शुभ-कृत्, त्, m. epithet of the
thirty-sixth or tenth year of Jupiter's cycle of sixty
years.
—शुभ-क्षण, अस्, अम्, m. n. an auspicious
or lucky moment.
—शुभ-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going
well or beautifully, graceful, elegant; propitious, for-
tunate.
—शुभ-गन्धक, अस्, आ, अम्, good-
scented; (अम्), n. gum-myrrh.
—शुभ-ग्रह, अस्,
m. an auspicious planet, lucky star (such as Jupiter,
Venus, Mercury, and the moon when more than half
full).
—शुभग्रहोदय (˚ह-उद्˚), अस्, m. the
rising of an auspicious planet.
—शुभङ्-कर, अस्,
आ or ई, अम्, conferring happiness or fortune; auspicious,
propitious; (ई), f. Pārvatī.
—शुभ-जानि, इस्, इस्, इ,
having a beautiful wife.
—शुभ-द, अस्, आ, अम्,
granting happiness, propitious, auspicious; (अस्), m.
the sacred fig-tree (= अश्वत्थ).
—शुभ-दन्ती, f.
a woman with good teeth; the female elephant of
Puṣpa-danta or of the north-west quarter, (also read
शुभ्र-दन्ती.)
—शुभ-दृष्टि, इस्, f. an auspicious
look or aspect.
—शुभ-धर, अस्, m. a proper N.
[]
—शुभ-नामा, f. epithet of the fifth lunar night.
—शुभ-पत्त्रिका, f. ‘having auspicious leaves,’ a
kind of shrub (= शाल-पर्णी).
—शुभ-फल, अम्,
n. auspicious result, good or happy consequence.
—शुभम्-भावुक, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘disposed to be
bright,’ resplendent, decorated, ornamented.
—शुभ-
योग, अस्, m. a particular astronomical Yoga, (see
शुभ.)
—शुभ-लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, having
an auspicious sign or symptom; marked or charac-
terized by felicity.
—शुभ-लग्न, अस्, अम्, m. n. the
rising of an auspicious constellation, a lucky moment.
—शुभ-वार्त्ता, f. good news.
—शुभ-वासन,
अस्, m. auspicious perfuming; perfume for the mouth.
—शुभ-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a particular religious
observance (kept on the twelfth day in one of the
halves of the month Kārttika).
—शुभ-शंसिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, indicative of good luck.
—शुभ-शील, अस्, आ,
अम्, well-disposed, having a good disposition.
—शु-
भ-संयुत, अस्, आ, अम्, endowed with prosperity
or happiness, blissful.
—शुभ-सप्तमी-व्रत, अम्,
n., N. of a particular religious observance.
—शुभ-
सूचनी, f. ‘indicating good,’ N. of a female deity
worshipped by women in times of calamity, (she is
also called Su-vacanī.)
—शुभ-स्थली, f. any
auspicious place, a room or hall in which sacrifices are
offered.
—शुभाक्ष (˚भ-अक्˚), अस्, m. ‘auspicious-
eyed,’ epithet of Śiva.
—शुभागम (˚भ-आग्˚),
अम्, n. epithet of certain Tantra works regarded as
especially orthodox.
—शुभाङ्ग (˚भ-अङ्˚), अस्, ई,
अम्, handsome-limbed, beautifully formed, handsome,
elegant; (अस्), m., N. of a lexicographer; of another
person; (ई), f. a handsome woman; N. of Rati
(wife of the god of love); of the wife of Kuvera
(god of wealth).
—शुभाचार (˚भ-आच्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, pure in practices or observances, virtuous; (आ),
f. epithet of a female attendant on Umā; [cf. शु-
भा.]
—शुभाञ्जन (˚भ-अञ्˚), अस्, m. the tree
Hyperanthera Moringa, (see शोभाञ्जन.)
—शु-
भानन (˚भ-आन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, handsome-faced,
good-looking; (आ), f. a handsome woman.
—शु-
भानन्दा (˚भ-आन्˚), f., N. of a goddess.
—शु-
भान्वित (˚भ-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, endowed with
prosperity or good fortune, happy, prosperous.
—शु-
भापाङ्गा (˚भ-अप्˚), f. ‘a woman who has beauti-
ful eye-corners,’ a beautiful woman.
—शुभाशुभ
(˚भ-अश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, prosperous and unfortunate,
good and evil; (अम्), n. good and evil, good and
bad fortune, weal and woe.
—शुभाशुभ-लक्-
षण, अम्, n. a mark or sign of good or bad
fortune, a good or evil omen.
—शुभेतर (˚भ-
इत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, other than auspicious, unlucky, in-
auspicious; evil, bad.
—शुभोदर्क (˚भ-उद्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, having prosperous results or happy con-
sequences; causing happiness.

शुभंयु, उस्, उस्, उ, happy, fortunate, pros-
perous, auspicious.

शुभान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining bright, brilliant;
(आस्), m. pl. (according to some) epithet of the
Maruts, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 165, 3.
शुभानैः = शोभमानैर् वचनैः.)
शुभिका, f., Ved. a garland formed of flowers.

शुभ्र, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, radiant, bright;
white; (अस्), m. white (the colour); sandal; (अम्),
n. silver; talc; green vitriol; rock or fossil salt;
(आ), f. the Ganges; crystal; bamboo-manna; [cf.
Old Germ. sūbar; Mod Germ. sauber, ‘clean;’
Angl. Sax. syfr.]
—शुभ्र-कृत्, त्, m. the thirty-
sixth year of Jupiter's cycle; [cf. शुभ-कृत्.]
—शुभ्र-खादि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having shining
rings, having bright weapons (said of the Maruts;
Sāy. = शोभनायुध or शोभन-हविष्क, Ṛg-
veda VIII. 20, 4).
—शुभ्र-ता, f. or शुभ्र-त्व,
अम्, n. whiteness.
—शुभ्र-दन्ती, f. the female
elephant of Puṣpa-danta, the elephant of the north-
west quarter, (see शुभ-दन्ती.)
—शुभ्र-रश्मि,
इस्, m. ‘white-rayed,’ the moon.
—शुभ्र-शस्तम,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. shining very much, (according to
some either for शुभ्र-शस्त-तम or for शुभ्र-
शस्-तम.)
—शुभ्रांशु (˚र-अं˚), उस्, m. ‘white-
rayed,’ the moon; camphor.
—शुभ्रालु (˚र-आलु),
[]
उस्, m. a white esculent root; a particular plant
with a tuberous root (= महिष-कन्द).
—शु-
भ्रा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessing radiance,
shining.

शुभ्रि, इस्, इस्, इ, shining bright (Ved., Sāy. = शो-
भन); (इस्), m. an epithet of Brahmā.

सुभाञ्जन सुभाञ्जन, अस्, m. the tree Hy-
peranthera Morunga, (also read शुभाञ्जन.)

सूभर्व सू-भर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (for सु-
भर्व; see rt. भर्व्), well-fed, having good food
or pasturage, (Sāy. = शोभन-भक्ष, Ṛg-veda X.
94, 3; = शोभन-चरण, Ṛg-veda X. 102, 5.)
